BiblicalUsage: Mechir is named once, in the genealogy of Judah, as the father of Eshton. He is the son of Chelub the brother of Shuah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single line is still a life: Mechir raised a son, and the son's name is kept, and the genealogy is God's way of saying that fathers matter.
